messages:
sophie: Heads-up: Prospect 'Havenly' asked for a perf POC next week. Targets: sustained 120 qps per region, avg ~256 tokens, p99 <300ms, multi-region failover. They prefer Private but will consider Dedicated. Also sent KMS/security questionnaire. Need runbook + quick hosted vs dedicated cost stub. cc @raj @jules

raj: Understood. We need model variant and whether batching + KV cache allowed. Quantized models change latency curve.

sophie: They want "redwood-ggml-large-q4". Batching ok but they insist on p99 <300ms. KMS worry: are decrypts per-request?

jules: Draft run steps: warm 20 qps 15m, ramp to 120 over 20m, 4h soak at 120 qps, 30m spike to 240 qps, then failover test us-west1 -> eu-west1. Trace sampling 1%.

matt: Ops checklist: set timeout 6s, per-worker concurrency 8, enable KV prefix cache, pre-warm models, capture KMS unwrap spans and cold-starts. I'll schedule and run.

raj: Recommendation: run both q4 and fp16 to compare variance. Dedicated sizing estimate: 6x A100-equivalent GPUs gives headroom for 120 qps with our batching.

finance-bot: Rough cost stub: Hosted (q4) ~ $620/day for the test window; Dedicated (pro-rated) ~ $220/day plus KMS and egress. Final after exact GPU-hours.

security-bot: New questionnaire created: https://redwood-internal/q/HVN-2026-KMS. Key answers: envelope flow, DEK caching TTL, whether KMS is called per inference, HSM option.

sophie: Important: Havenly needs explicit confirmation KMS isn't called per-response for Private/Dedicated. Can we provide a short explainer?

jules: Short explainer: we use envelope encryption. DEKs are unwrapped at key rotation and cached in the runtime; KMS unwrap is not performed per inference. I'll draft a one-pager and sequence diagram.

matt: I'll add a small smoke that rotates keys and measures the latency impact and tag KMS spans so security can see timings.

ops-bot: Tentative run scheduled: 2026-04-07T15:00:00Z run id hvn-poc-1809 (assigned to matt).

sophie: Thanks — please post the final runbook, pricing stub, and KMS one-pager here by EOD so I can send to the customer.

raj: Will post sizing notes and perf caveats by 17:00 PT.

jules: I'll attach runbook + security one-pager by EOD.

matt: Confirmed. I'll include k6/fortio snippets and the smoke scripts.
